title: spec(types,plugin-dashboard,app-shell,plugin-designer): widgets[] entries read by the slot's element type, DashboardWidgetSchema['type'] drops the component type, the object-chart producers name ObjectChartSchema (objectui#11514, part 1)
body:
Part of #11514

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

Every dashboard surface reads a `widgets[]` entry by the slot's element type, `DashboardWidgetSchema['type']` drops the component type (objectui#11483's closure), and both `object-chart` producers name `ObjectChartSchema` with no cast. Two of the card's items are held for a decision and are not in this PR: the `object-metric` producer, whose dialect premise measured false (branch B, and B's TypeScript twin does not exist), and the slot-component passthrough, which cannot become a declared node without changing what renders. Both are questions in the card's `os-dev-report`, so this PR does not close the card, and the four V1 census sites stay red until those two and objectui#11466's registry entry land.

## What changed — before and after

| | before (`fc7db059f`) | after |
|---|---|---|
| `DashboardWidgetSchema['type']` (TS face) | `DashboardWidgetTypeName \| DashboardComponentWidgetType` | `DashboardWidgetTypeName`, the zod twin's set |
| `{ type: 'metric-card', title }` directly in `widgets[]` | compiles (the MEASURED LIMIT pin); both zod faces refuse | `tsc` refuses it too; zod faces unchanged |
| component arm assignable to `DashboardWidgetSchema` | yes | no |
| read type of a `widgets[]` entry in `DashboardRenderer`, `DashboardGridLayout`, `DashboardWithConfig`, `isLegacyRetiredWidget` and the designer's `DashboardEditor` | `DashboardWidgetSchema` | `DashboardComponentSchema['widgets'][number]` |
| `DashboardRendererProps['onWidgetsReorder']` parameter | `DashboardWidgetSchema[]` | `DashboardComponentSchema['widgets']` |
| app-shell `DashboardPreview`'s reorder handler | `DashboardWidgetSchema[]` | `DashboardComponentSchema['widgets']` (type-only) |
| `WidgetDispatch['chartType']` | `string` | `SeriesChartFamily`: the 12 series families, each a member of `ObjectChartSchema['chartType']` |
| both `object-chart` producers | untyped literal, `chartType` typed `string` | `satisfies ObjectChartSchema`, no cast |
| `DashboardRenderer`'s static `chart` producer | `chartType: resolvedWidgetType` | `chartType: dispatch.chartType`, the same value inside the series branch |

Nothing renders differently. `SERIES_CHART_TYPES` holds the same 12 values, `classifyWidgetType` routes every type as before, and each node carries the same `chartType` it carried. No node shape, branch or runtime path moves. The two `SchemaRenderer` casts in the producers' render sites stay: the branches they cover (Q1, Q2 and the registry entry) are not decided here.

## The `object-metric` premise, measured before any edit: B

The premise: every operator the dashboard filter bar emits translates losslessly into the spec's condition list, the authored bag's `properties.filter` (`z.array(ViewFilterRuleSchema)`). Each bar control's committed value went through the real `resolveDashboardFilterDefs` / `buildWidgetScopedFilter` / `mergeFilters` in a throwaway probe (not committed).

| bar control, and the value it commits | condition built | condition-list spelling | bag zod face | same rows, record vs rules (in-memory matcher) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `TextFilter`, the trimmed string | `{ name: { $contains: 'acme' } }` | `contains` | accepts | yes |
| `TextFilter` on a `number` def, `Number(v)` | `{ amount: 5 }` | `equals` | accepts | yes |
| `SelectFilter` (`select` / `lookup`), one option value | `{ stage: 'won' }` | `equals` | accepts | yes |
| an authored array `defaultValue` (the bar commits one value) | `{ stage: { $in: [...] } }` | `in` | accepts | yes |
| `DateRangeFilter`, `{ preset }` | `{ created_at: { $gte: '{current_month_start}', $lte: '{current_month_end}' } }` | `greater_than_or_equal` + `less_than_or_equal` | accepts | not run (macro bounds) |
| `DateRangeFilter`, `{ from, to }` ISO days | `$gte` / `$lte` | the same two | accepts | yes |
| an authored bare date `defaultValue` | `{ created_at: '2026-01-10' }` | `equals` | accepts | yes |
| two bound filters | `{ $and: [...] }` | concatenation of the rule lists | accepts | yes |

The bar's operator set is `$and`, `$contains`, `$gte`, `$in`, `$lte` and implicit equality, and each has a spelling on its own. Losslessness fails twice anyway:

1. **The broadcast's `$and` carries a second dialect.** `mergeFilters` conjoins the bar's condition with the widget's own `filter` (or the `provider: 'object'` filter). That operand is the spec's `DashboardWidget.filter`, `FilterConditionSchema` (MongoDB-style; it accepts `$or`, measured). `$or`, `$not`, `$like` and `$exists` have no condition-list spelling: the rule list is a flat conjunction, and `ViewFilterRuleSchema` refuses `operator: 'or'`. Measured: `{ $and: [ { $or: [...] }, { name: { $contains: 'acme' } } ] }` has no spelling.
2. **The bar's own operators move what renders once they sit in the bag.** On the spec-shape aggregate branch (a structured `aggregate.groupBy`, through `objectAggregateSpecQuery`), `ObjectStackAdapter` accepts the record `where` and refuses the rule list with `UnloweredAggregateWhereError`; the tile then draws that error instead of its number (measured at the UI, see Acceptance notes). The analytics branch lowers both to the same `where` (`{"name":{"$contains":"acme"}}` either way).

Control: `$contains` translated to `[{ field: 'name', operator: 'contains', value: 'acme' }]` round-trips through `ObjectMetricBlockSchema`'s `properties.filter` unchanged, and the record form in the same bag is refused by the face itself, which is why C stays shut.

So filter-carrying metric widgets keep building the flat, ObjectQL-dialect `object-metric` node, which is what they build today: this PR does not touch that producer. B's TypeScript twin does not exist: `@object-ui/types` declares no flat `object-metric` on `main` or on PR #11512's branch (only `ObjectMetricBlockNode`, the bag). Where it would live is the report's question 1.

## V1 census (H1)

Probe: PR #11512's branch (`ff7f748e`) merged with `main` `fc7db059f` through `git merge-tree` in a throwaway worktree, then this diff applied. Nothing was committed or pushed from it, and it is removed.

- **Before this diff:** 8 lines, the card's 4 sites in plugin-dashboard's src and test programs (`DashboardGridLayout.tsx` ×2, `DashboardRenderer.tsx` ×2, each in both programs).
- **After:** the same 8 lines at the same 4 sites. 0 new lines in plugin-dashboard src and tests, types src and examples, app-shell src and tests, and plugin-designer src and tests. The types test program shows 1 line, `node-recursion-point-8344`'s drift ratchet: it is objectui#11515's three new TS twins leaving that list on the merge with `main` (dropping those three names from the probe's expected set turns it green, with `dashboard` still in the set), not this diff.
- **What holds the 8 lines, per branch** (a probe-only `DeclaredNode` return annotation on both `getComponentSchema`s): the `object-metric` branch (flat keys that `ObjectMetricBlockNode` refuses by name), question 1; `plugin-dashboard:metric` (`DASHBOARD_NODE_TYPES.metric` typed `string`), objectui#11466's registry entry; the slot-component passthrough, question 2; and `DashboardGridLayout`'s static `pivot` (`...options` does not state `PivotTableSchema`'s three required axes). Both `object-chart` branches and the static `chart` branch: 0.
- The lead patch (`11466-dashboard-partial.patch`) was read, not applied. Not taken from it: the `UNTYPED_WIDGET_SCHEMA` placeholder (it changes what a typeless or unknown-type widget draws), the `CustomNodeRegistry` entry (objectui#11466's), and the bag `object-metric` whose `properties.filter` received the widget's MongoDB-style record (C at runtime, hidden from `tsc` by `any`).

## Readers of the narrowed type (H4)

Needed an edit, each found by `tsc` or a gate going red:

- `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`: `DashboardRenderer`, `DashboardGridLayout`, `DashboardWithConfig`, `isLegacyRetiredWidget`, and two test readers (`DashboardGridLayout.persistence`, `DashboardWithConfig.layout-11388`).
- `@object-ui/app-shell`: `DashboardPreview`'s reorder handler (type-only; reverse-verified below).
- `@object-ui/plugin-designer`: `DashboardEditor` (its preview, `WidgetCard`, `WidgetPropertyPanel` and the measure probe), and three test readers. Not in the card's list: its build went red on 3 lines once the component type left the widget arm.
- `@object-ui/types` tests: the objectui#11483 pin, the objectui#7952 pin (its "the arm is assignable" row flips), and `zod-mirror-parity`'s `KnownDrift` row and header totals.
- Docs: the plugin page (`content/docs/plugins/plugin-dashboard.mdx`) and the plugin-dashboard README taught `const widgets: DashboardWidgetSchema[] = dashboard.widgets`; `check:doc-snippets` failed both blocks. Both now narrow an entry on `type` and read the widget key off the widget arm (a probe confirmed the narrowed `colorVariant` keeps its declared type).

Needed nothing: `@object-ui/core`'s `buildWidgetScopedFilter` (its parameter, a `Pick` of `DashboardWidgetSchema`'s `id` and `filterBindings`, accepts either arm), `useWidgetSubCaption` (a structural `{ id, options }`), `DatasetWidget` (`widget: any`), app-shell's `DashboardWidgetInspector` and the rest of `DashboardPreview` (both read entries off an `any` draft), and `apps/*`, which hold no TypeScript reader of the slot type. `examples/schema-catalog` and `@object-ui/sdui-parser` read the zod schemas only.

## Pins, reverse verification, ablation

- `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/dashboard-producer-node-types-11514.test.tsx` (28 tests): type rows hold `SeriesChartFamily` inside `ObjectChartSchema['chartType']`, the slot-entry type, and the reorder parameter; runtime rows render every series family through both surfaces and have the zod `ObjectChartSchema` judge the node each one hands the renderer.
- `metric-card-needs-value-11483.test.ts`: the MEASURED LIMIT section is gone; an `@ts-expect-error` row holds that `tsc` refuses the valueless card, beside the zod faces.
- **Ablation** (`ablation-replace.mjs`, wrap mode): `'gauge'` planted in `SERIES_CHART_FAMILIES` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `757a9ec2` to `d67406bb`). plugin-dashboard `tsc` src: 2 errors, both `satisfies ObjectChartSchema` sites; test program: 3 (the same two plus the type row); vitest: 2 failed (`gauge` on each surface), 28 passed. Restored: blob equal to `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Reverse verification**: `DashboardPreview.tsx` at the base, app-shell `tsc --noEmit`: TS2322 at its `onWidgetsReorder` prop: a handler taking `DashboardWidgetSchema[]` is not assignable. Restored from `HEAD`: blob `eae5909f` equal, tree clean.

- **Added:** `11514-types-widget-arm-type` (`@object-ui/types` minor, with its breaking meaning), `11514-dashboard-slot-entry-types` (`@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` minor: a reorder handler typed `DashboardWidgetSchema[]` stops compiling), `11514-designer-dashboard-entry-type` and `11514-app-shell-dashboard-preview-reorder` (patch, type-only).
- **Dated notes (2026-10-03, append-only):** `11483-metric-card-needs-value` ("What does not move"), `7952-dashboard-widgets-component-arm` ("Consumers"), `11348-dashboard-widget-reads` (its sites read through `DashboardWidgetSchema`, assignable), `dashboard-widget-type-closed-enum` (its objectui#11483 note says the TS widget arm still reads `metric-card`).
- **Read and left alone:** `11467-metric-card-arm-inputs` (its objectui#11483 note's "both faces" are the validator faces; `title` reads off both arms, still true), `11070-dashboard-keys-round11` (its objectui#11483 note is about the zod vocabulary), `11022-strict-widget-slot-registered-inputs`, `10859-dashboard-node-keys` (node keys unchanged), `11355-small-p1-sites-r2` (`isAnimationActive` on the `object-chart` node, still true), `11478-anyschema-declared-node-types`, and the rest of `check:changeset-claims`' 26 file-name matches: none names a symbol this diff moves.

## Acceptance notes

- **Out of scope, reported for the seat to file (a reproducible defect).** An authored `object-metric` whose `properties.filter` is a rule list and whose `aggregate.groupBy` is structured (`{ field, dateGranularity }`) draws an error. Measured through the real `SchemaRenderer` with a real `ObjectStackAdapter` (fetch stubbed): `ObjectMetricBlockSchema` accepts the node, and the tile reads "aggregate('opportunity'): the spec-shape branch received a `where` array that is not a filter". Controls: the same bag with a string `groupBy` draws 42 through the analytics branch; the flat record-filter node with the structured `groupBy` draws 42 through the data query. `ObjectMetricWidget` hands the unlowered rule list to `objectAggregateSpecQuery`. Option A for this card would need it fixed first.
- **Not measured at a public door.** The spec defaults an absent widget `type` to `metric`; objectui's mirror strips that default, and a typeless widget reaches the passthrough and draws the OBJUI-001 panel. Carrier: question 2's resolution.
- **File surface, beyond the claim's list:** plugin-designer's `DashboardEditor` and its three tests, the two docs pages, the objectui#7952 pin, the two plugin-dashboard test readers, `isLegacyRetiredWidget`, and the static `chart` producer's `chartType`. Each is the same retype, forced by the narrowing or the same producer class, and is named above.
